title.ja: レビュー工数50%削減を目指す、LLMベンチマークとHuman-in-the-loop設計
title.en: Toward a 50% reduction in review effort: LLM benchmarking and human-in-the-loop design

summary.ja: 複数モデルの評価と、人が最終判断を担うレビュー支援の設計。50%削減は目標であり、実測された成果ではありません。
summary.en: Comparing models and designing review assistance with people retaining the final decision. The 50% reduction is a target, not a measured result.

relevance.rationale: An authored, substantive evaluation article directly relevant to applied AI and workflow design. It supports the existing evaluation case study rather than representing a new accomplishment; keep it out of homepage selection unless the owner chooses otherwise. English title and summary are editorial translations requiring human review.
